# Synthetic face fixture

synthetic-pair.png was created on 2026-09-16 with the built-in image generation tool.
It depicts two fictional adults, not imported media or named real people.

SHA-256: `32f1f4e898278f7db3589acdd9c6037ee79dd40e51fecd76251e642a8b5cf767`.

Prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: synthetic software test fixture for face detection, not a real person. Generate a single square photograph of two entirely fictional adult people standing next to each other facing camera, head and shoulders, both faces large, clear, fully unobstructed, neutral expressions, even studio light, plain light gray background. One adult with short dark hair, one adult with curly auburn hair, visibly different faces. Realistic photographic skin and facial anatomy. No text, no logos, no watermark, no other people. Both heads entirely inside frame with margin.

The local Docker acceptance script copies the fixture into temporary synthetic libraries.
Duplicate files exercise nonempty observations and clustering deterministically.
This is functional evidence only: duplicates are not a recall, precision, identity,
cosplay robustness, or threshold-calibration dataset.
